packageRules.description: pnpm 11 refuses to resolve lockfile entries younger than its own minimumReleaseAge (1440 min) and CI installs --frozen-lockfile, so a fresh release would break the install. Seven days clears that window sevenfold. Note Renovate cannot read pnpm's setting itself (renovate#41652), so the two are kept in step by hand.
A major gets longer to settle before it is proposed.
One pull request for the frontend.
One pull request for the server.

The reason this repo runs Renovate rather than Dependabot. SPEC §06 states that every version pin lives in exactly one of .nvmrc, rust-toolchain.toml or the packageManager field, and Dependabot has no manager for any of the three — so the doctrine's own files were the only ones nothing watched. Grouped so a toolchain move arrives as one reviewable change.
